name: python-exclusions
body: Python package discovery must not descend into generated, dependency, or virtual-environment trees: __pycache__, .venv, venv, .tox, .git, .hg, .mypy_cache, .pytest_cache, .ruff_cache, node_modules, .eggs and *.egg-info are never scan roots. Consistent with domain.entity.scan-exclusion (target/, vendor/, node_modules/, .worktrees/) — these are the Python-specific additions to that exclusion set. Tension with import resolution: a virtualenv is excluded from discovery yet the `ty` engine may still need it as a resolution input; the environment model is an open point (requirements.note.python-frontend-open-points).
